name: aws-study
description: Multi-Lambda TypeScript scaffold orchestrated with AWS SAM. Local-first testing: unit (Vitest), E2E (Playwright), performance (k6), smoke.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.local:start: sam build && sam local start-api -p 3000 --warm-containers EAGER --env-vars env.json
scripts.local:invoke:health: sam build && sam local invoke HealthFunction -e events/health-check-event.json --env-vars env.json
scripts.local:invoke:hello: sam build && sam local invoke HelloFunction -e events/hello-world-event.json --env-vars env.json
scripts.test:perf: echo 'API must be running (npm run local:start). Then:' && echo '  k6 run tests/performance/smoke-test.js' && echo '  k6 run tests/performance/hello-load-test.js' && echo '  k6 run tests/performance/health-load-test.js'
